bench.machine: Apple host CPU; receipt/header metadata only
bench.rule: no hardware measurement claim without hardware

claim_boundary: Static sidecar artifact. No hardware measurement. Passing an early stage is not evidence of anything except not-yet-dead. Survival of every stage is NOT_YET_DEAD, never verified, never a promotion.

funnel_child_workunits.can_decide: The hypothesis is a well-formed allocation of TOTAL EXECUTABLE INFORMATION (heterogeneous bits are expressible; uniform bits are allowed).
funnel_child_workunits.cannot_decide: Teacher fit, held-out fidelity, route identity, tokens, capability, physical NR, a complete NX, or an EBPW number.

funnel_child_workunits.can_decide: The candidate reconstructs or predicts on the teacher corpus it was fit to.
funnel_child_workunits.cannot_decide: Held-out numerical validity, route stability, logit/token identity, capability, or anything physical.

funnel_child_workunits.can_decide: Local numerical fidelity on unseen X for the stated organ.
funnel_child_workunits.cannot_decide: Route identity, complete-token argmax, coherent generation, capability, NR, NX, or EBPW.

funnel_child_workunits.can_decide: On the measured traces, the student selects the same experts as the teacher.
funnel_child_workunits.cannot_decide: Logit/token identity beyond routing, capability, physical lowering, or EBPW.

funnel_child_workunits.can_decide: Token-level identity on the stated probe (argmax / short decode).
funnel_child_workunits.cannot_decide: Bounded capability, a physical NR, a complete NX, or EBPW. 16 greedy tokens are not capability.

funnel_child_workunits.can_decide: The candidate matched the incumbent on every substantive capability axis of the stated suite.
funnel_child_workunits.cannot_decide: Physical NR lowering, a complete NX, protected token_ns, or EBPW.

funnel_child_workunits.can_decide: A Physical NR artifact exists and lowered without a disclosed failure. STATIC_ONLY: this sidecar did not run a kernel.
funnel_child_workunits.cannot_decide: A complete NX, protected complete-token timing, or EBPW. PLAN_ONLY / NOT_IMPLEMENTED is not a pass; it is a refusal.

funnel_child_workunits.can_decide: A source-independent complete NX artifact exists as more than sealed metadata.
funnel_child_workunits.cannot_decide: EBPW, protected TPS, or promotion. SCAFFOLD_ONLY / SEALED_METADATA_ONLY_NOT_FOR_PROMOTION is a refusal, not a pass.

funnel_child_workunits.can_decide: A complete-system EBPW ledger exists with every required field counted.
funnel_child_workunits.cannot_decide: Protected token_ns, joules, or promotion. null complete_system_bytes is a refusal, not a number.

gaps_closed: ladder(candidate): cheapest-first stages, each with can_decide / cannot_decide, derived from meta_funnel.GATES plus an optional cheapest_falsifier stage
screen(candidate): stop at the first kill or refusal; later stages are not called; cost is the cost_class paid, not a hardware number
saved(candidate): names the concrete un-launched future.meta_funnel.gate.N.name workunits from GATES, not an invented count
negative_index.refuse_if_dead is consulted before any stage; a hit launches zero stages
survival of every stage is NOT_YET_DEAD with verified=false; a pass is not verification
missing required input is REFUSED, never silently PASSED
negative_findings: this module is not in tools/future/orchestration.py BINDINGS; invoke() will raise UnknownBinding until the connector is extended. Naming a frontier here is not a binding
saved() names funnel gates, not candidate_planner descendants — queue lineage is a different child-work graph and was not merged
flash_schools cheapest_falsifier is a prose kill criterion; without falsifier_observation the cheapest stage REFUSES rather than inventing a measurement
negative-index consult during recovered-family screens: CLEAR
passing cheapest_falsifier or any funnel gate is not evidence of teacher fit, tokens, capability, NR, NX, EBPW, or promotion
this sidecar produces neither DIAGNOSTIC_RELATIVE nor PROTECTED_ABSOLUTE
purpose: Make cheap-falsifier-then-stop automatic: a candidate killed at the cheapest stage never launches later meta-funnel gates, and the work not done is named from those gates.
recovered_implementation: tools/future/meta_funnel.py GATES / Funnel.advance / Funnel.run / input_state / is_absent — composed, not forked; saved() names these gates
tools/future/negative_index.py refuse_if_dead — consulted before any stage
tools/future/flash_schools.py CANDIDATE_FIELDS.cheapest_falsifier — first ladder stage when the candidate names one
tools/future/candidate_planner.py descendants_of — lineage invalidation already exists; this module names funnel child work, not queue descendants
tools/future/qualification_pipeline.py STAGES — GPU sequencer; not forked (this ladder has no lease and no GPU)
tools/future/evidence_dag.py V0–V9 — evidence-level hierarchy, a different ladder; not forked
tools/future/scar_scheduling.py admit — scheduling-side scar refusal; the pre-stage gate here is refuse_if_dead

resident_callable.fails_closed: absent input -> REFUSED, never PASSED; negative-index hit -> REFUSED_DEAD and zero stages run; survival -> NOT_YET_DEAD with verified=false, never VERIFIED
resident_callable.workunit: one CPU_ANALYSIS unit; screen one candidate cheapest-first and name the meta_funnel gates that were therefore not launched
